description: The IMF Data portal gives access to the International Monetary Fund's economic and financial datasets, including the World Economic Outlook with national accounts, inflation, unemployment, balance of payments, fiscal and trade data from 1980 with five-year projections, the Fiscal Monitor, consumer price indexes by division, the Currency Composition of Official Foreign Exchange Reserves (COFER), labour statistics and the TAXFIT microsimulation tool for 34 emerging and developing economies. It is run by the International Monetary Fund. Coverage is global by country, with monthly, quarterly and annual series depending on the dataset. Data can be explored in dashboards and tables, downloaded, pulled into Excel with an add-in, or queried through an SDMX API, free of charge; reuse follows the IMF's copyright and usage terms, which the page read links but does not quote. Caveats: country data are reported by national authorities and revised, projections are IMF staff judgements, and the portal's set of datasets has changed with its redesign, so older series may sit elsewhere. For simulation it provides macro-financial baselines, cross-border positions and projections for stress scenarios, and for resilience and cascading failure studies of how shocks move between economies. It is related to the World Bank Global Financial Development Database record in this catalogue, which gives structural measures of the same financial systems.
